pass_rule: Approved dependency has a clear mapping to paper mechanism and passes a smallest 3-seed diagnostic before 20 seeds.
current_evidence: Dependency-free Node2Vec/ELPH/DLS proxies are useful diagnostics but not paper-faithful mechanisms.

input_required: Run MovieLens Figure 4a only, seeds 0-2, comparing DU-Net-style, MF-centered Linear UCB, and Myopic.

pass_rule: All three policies must use the same recovered split, metric, backend settings, and cycle schedule.
current_evidence: Smallest diagnostic isolates the target Figure 4a gap before any 20-seed promotion.

input_required: Improve or explain the current reward-weighted DU-Net-vs-Linear-UCB gap.
action: Compare against frozen baseline reward-weighted gap and paper scale ratio.
pass_rule: Promotable if recovered mechanism increases the positive gap or explains why the paper scale differs.

input_required: Address the current full-test RMSE reversal.
action: Check whether full-RMSE reversal is resolved, explained, or proven irrelevant to the paper metric.
pass_rule: Promotable if full-RMSE ordering becomes DU-Net-favored, near-tied with source-backed explanation, or explicitly not the paper metric.

input_required: Preserve the high-rating region support for DU-Net.

pass_rule: Recovered mechanism should not erase the high-rating/reward-region support unless it replaces the metric interpretation.

input_required: Decide whether to promote from 3 seeds to 20 seeds.
action: Promote to 20 seeds only after the 3-seed diagnostic improves a primary blocker; otherwise freeze and report the diagnostic.
pass_rule: Promote only if at least one primary blocker improves and no new contradiction is introduced.
current_evidence: A 20-seed rerun is expensive and should only follow a source-backed positive diagnostic.
